payload.title: Clarify automatic portfolio non-selection and terminal analysis status
payload.description:
A finalized living Report can describe every assessed candidate as rejected even when no optimizer launch was attempted, and an incomplete semantic result can be presented as pending. Stakeholders need selection outcomes and analysis completeness stated in plain language.

Feature: Honest automatic-run status

Scenario: policy does not select an assessed candidate
Given an automatic portfolio run assessed candidates
And no optimizer launch was attempted for candidates that did not pass the policy gates
When the stakeholder Report is rendered
Then those candidates are described as not selected rather than rejected
And launched targets and actual launch failures remain distinguishable

Scenario: semantic analysis ends incomplete
Given portfolio inventory is complete
And a scheduled semantic diagnosis ends with incomplete evidence
When the terminal Report is rendered
Then inventory is labeled complete
And semantic analysis is labeled incomplete rather than pending.
